script: The North Star is not the brightest star in the sky. Polaris ranks around 48th in brightness. It is famous because it sits almost directly above Earth's North Pole. So it barely moves while the other stars wheel around it. Because Earth's axis slowly wobbles, Vega will be the North Star in about 12,000 years.
